inferred_requirements.title: Strip 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor Direct Identifiers
inferred_requirements.description: The export pipeline must identify and remove or redact all 18 categories of direct identifiers specified under the HIPAA Safe Harbor method prior to analytics ingestion.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly and unambiguously stated in the user prompt.

inferred_requirements.title: De-identification Validation and Audit Logging
inferred_requirements.description: The pipeline must generate an immutable audit log recording the timestamp, record count processed, and verification status confirming the complete removal of the 18 Safe Harbor identifiers before downstream transmission.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Regulatory frameworks require demonstrable proof of compliance to avoid severe HIPAA penalties for data leaks. -> Why 2: An automated validation step coupled with an audit log creates an unalterable trace of the de-identification process. -> Why 3: No dataset may be transmitted to analytics ingestion without programmatic proof of zero remaining direct identifiers.
